description:
Full intelligence for a single CVE: CVSS, KEV status, EPSS, CISA SSVC
(exploitation/automatable/technical_impact), P1-P4 priority with rationale,
affected products/versions, Debian/Ubuntu/Alpine fixed builds per release
(`distro_fixes`), and (live) public-exploit signal.

Args:
    cve_id: e.g. "CVE-2025-12345".
    include_poc: also query GitHub for public PoC/exploit repos (live).
name: enrich_cve
title: Enrich a CVE
